title: Raspberry Pi 4 mounting plate
prompt: Mounting plate for a Raspberry Pi 4 so I can screw it into a project box. Same footprint as the board (85 x 56 mm), 3 mm thick, with holes for M2.5 screws (2.7 mm) on the Pi's 58 x 49 mm pattern. The holes sit 3.5 mm in from the edges at the end away from the USB ports, like on the real board.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
Four 2.7 mm (M2.5 clearance) holes on the Pi's 58 x 49 mm rectangle
Exactly four holes, nothing else cut out

notes: Raspberry Pi 4 mechanical drawing: 85 x 56 board, M2.5 holes 58 x 49 apart, 3.5 mm from the edges.
